user_story: As a user, I want to filter tasks by category so that I can focus on a specific area.

positive.title: Filter tasks by a single category
steps: Select a category from the category filter dropdown
positive.expected_result: Tasks belonging to the selected category are displayed.

positive.title: Filter tasks by multiple categories
steps: Select multiple categories from the category filter dropdown
positive.expected_result: Tasks belonging to any of the selected categories are displayed.

negative.title: Filter tasks without selecting any category
steps: Do not select any categories from the dropdown
negative.expected_result: No tasks are displayed, and a warning message prompts the user to select at least one category.

negative.title: Select invalid category from dropdown
steps: Inject invalid data to simulate an invalid category selection
negative.expected_result: System throws an error or refreshes to a valid state without crashing.

edge.title: Filter tasks with the maximum number of categories
steps: Select all available categories from the category filter dropdown
edge.expected_result: All tasks are displayed as all categories are selected without any performance issues.

edge.title: Filter tasks with no tasks assigned to a selected category
steps: Select a category that has no tasks assigned to it
edge.expected_result: A message indicating 'No tasks found' is displayed.
